g.text: | Strong Consistency | Always latest data | Banking |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | Eventual Consistency | Data becomes correct later | Social media |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | Causal Consistency | Maintains event order | Chat systems |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | Weak Consistency | No guarantee when update appears | DNS, caches |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | Read-your-writes | User sees own updates | User posts |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | Monotonic Reads | Never see older data | Replicated databases |
